# Command reference

Every API command, grouped as in the CLI. Safety: `read` (no side effects), `write` (changes data, free), `destructive` (deletes or hard to undo, needs `--yes`), `billable` (charges balance, needs `--yes`).

Global flags are listed in [cli.md](cli.md#global-flags).

## [account](account.md)

Reseller account: balance and transactions.

| command | safety | summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`dna account get`](account.md#dna-account-get) | read | Show the reseller account and its TRY/USD balances |
| [`dna account transactions`](account.md#dna-account-transactions) | read | List balance transactions (charges, refunds, deposits) |

## [contact](contact.md)

Contact handles (registrant, admin, tech, billing).

| command | safety | summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`dna contact create`](contact.md#dna-contact-create) | write | Create a reusable contact handle |
| [`dna contact get`](contact.md#dna-contact-get) | read | Show a contact handle and its verification state |
| [`dna contact resend-verification`](contact.md#dna-contact-resend-verification) | write | Send the contact verification notice again |
| [`dna contact update`](contact.md#dna-contact-update) | write | Update a contact handle (and the domains that use it) |
| [`dna contact verification`](contact.md#dna-contact-verification) | read | Show e-mail/phone verification status of a contact |

## [dns](dns.md)

DNS zone records of domains on the platform nameservers.

| command | safety | summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`dna dns add`](dns.md#dna-dns-add) | write | Add values to a DNS record set (creates the set if needed) |
| [`dna dns apply`](dns.md#dna-dns-apply) | write | Switch the domain to the platform nameservers so its DNS zone is served |
| [`dna dns delete`](dns.md#dna-dns-delete) | destructive | Remove one value from a DNS record set |
| [`dna dns list`](dns.md#dna-dns-list) | read | List the DNS records of a domain |
| [`dna dns update`](dns.md#dna-dns-update) | write | Replace a DNS record set with new values |

## [dnssec](dnssec.md)

DNSSEC (DS records) of domains.

| command | safety | summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`dna dnssec add`](dnssec.md#dna-dnssec-add) | write | Publish DS records at the registry (enable DNSSEC) |
| [`dna dnssec disable`](dnssec.md#dna-dnssec-disable) | destructive | Remove every DS record (disable DNSSEC) |
| [`dna dnssec get`](dnssec.md#dna-dnssec-get) | read | Show DNSSEC status, DS records and allowed algorithms |
| [`dna dnssec remove`](dnssec.md#dna-dnssec-remove) | destructive | Remove one DS record |

## [domain](domain.md)

Search, register, renew, transfer and manage domains.

| command | safety | summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`dna domain bulk-search`](domain.md#dna-domain-bulk-search) | read | Check availability and prices of several domains at once |
| [`dna domain contacts set-handles`](domain.md#dna-domain-contacts-set-handles) | write | Point a domain's contact roles at existing contact handles |
| [`dna domain contacts update`](domain.md#dna-domain-contacts-update) | write | Replace a domain's contacts with inline contact details |
| [`dna domain documents list`](domain.md#dna-domain-documents-list) | read | List registry documents of a domain (mostly .tr) |
| [`dna domain documents upload`](domain.md#dna-domain-documents-upload) | write | Upload registry documents for a domain |
| [`dna domain forward delete`](domain.md#dna-domain-forward-delete) | destructive | Remove the URL forwarding of a domain |
| [`dna domain forward get`](domain.md#dna-domain-forward-get) | read | Show the URL forwarding of a domain |
| [`dna domain forward set`](domain.md#dna-domain-forward-set) | write | Forward a domain to a URL |
| [`dna domain host add`](domain.md#dna-domain-host-add) | write | Create a child nameserver (glue record) such as ns1.example.com |
| [`dna domain host delete`](domain.md#dna-domain-host-delete) | destructive | Delete a child nameserver |
| [`dna domain host update`](domain.md#dna-domain-host-update) | write | Change a child nameserver's name or IP addresses |
| [`dna domain info`](domain.md#dna-domain-info) | read | Show full details of a domain |
| [`dna domain list`](domain.md#dna-domain-list) | read | List your domains |
| [`dna domain lock`](domain.md#dna-domain-lock) | write | Enable the transfer lock |
| [`dna domain nameservers set`](domain.md#dna-domain-nameservers-set) | write | Replace the nameservers of a domain |
| [`dna domain privacy`](domain.md#dna-domain-privacy) | write | Turn WHOIS privacy protection on or off |
| [`dna domain register`](domain.md#dna-domain-register) | billable | Register a domain using existing contact handles (charges balance) |
| [`dna domain register-with-contacts`](domain.md#dna-domain-register-with-contacts) | billable | Register a domain with inline contact details (charges balance) |
| [`dna domain renew`](domain.md#dna-domain-renew) | billable | Renew a domain (charges balance) |
| [`dna domain renew-check`](domain.md#dna-domain-renew-check) | read | Check whether a domain can be renewed and at what price |
| [`dna domain restore`](domain.md#dna-domain-restore) | billable | Restore a deleted domain from redemption (charges balance) |
| [`dna domain search`](domain.md#dna-domain-search) | read | Check if a domain is available and get its price |
| [`dna domain transfer`](domain.md#dna-domain-transfer) | billable | Transfer a domain in from another registrar (charges balance) |
| [`dna domain transfer-check`](domain.md#dna-domain-transfer-check) | read | Check whether a domain can be transferred in with an auth code |
| [`dna domain transfer-status`](domain.md#dna-domain-transfer-status) | read | Show the state of a pending transfer |
| [`dna domain unlock`](domain.md#dna-domain-unlock) | write | Disable the transfer lock (needed before transferring out) |
| [`dna domain update-auth-code`](domain.md#dna-domain-update-auth-code) | write | Update the transfer auth (EPP) code and return it |

## [ssl](ssl.md)

SSL certificates: buy, configure, issue, reissue, revoke.

| command | safety | summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`dna ssl approvers`](ssl.md#dna-ssl-approvers) | read | List e-mail addresses allowed for e-mail validation |
| [`dna ssl check-csr`](ssl.md#dna-ssl-check-csr) | read | Decode a CSR and show its subject |

| [`dna ssl content`](ssl.md#dna-ssl-content) | read | Download the issued certificate and chain (PEM) |
| [`dna ssl generate-csr`](ssl.md#dna-ssl-generate-csr) | read | Generate a CSR and private key |
| [`dna ssl get`](ssl.md#dna-ssl-get) | read | Show certificate details (subscription, configuration, contacts) |
| [`dna ssl initialize`](ssl.md#dna-ssl-initialize) | billable | Buy an SSL certificate package for a domain (charges balance) |
| [`dna ssl reissue`](ssl.md#dna-ssl-reissue) | write | Reissue a certificate with a new CSR/key or approver |
| [`dna ssl revoke`](ssl.md#dna-ssl-revoke) | destructive | Revoke a certificate (irreversible) |
| [`dna ssl status`](ssl.md#dna-ssl-status) | read | Refresh and show certificate status |
